description.en: Old Wilf's room by the fire: the fireplace and the oak settle where Bess sleeps, the old oak chest, the rug and the lamp, the brass candlestick, his wedding photo, his glasses and his book of poems; crumpets on the toasting fork, Wordsworth's daffodils and hide-and-seek with Poppy.
description.sl: Soba starega Wilfa ob ognju: kamin in hrastova klop z visokim naslonom, kjer spi Bess, stara hrastova skrinja, preproga in svetilka, medeninast svečnik, njegova poročna fotografija, njegova očala in knjiga pesmi; ploščati kolački na vilicah za peko, Wordsworthovi narcisi in skrivalnice s Poppy.
description.it: La stanza del vecchio Wilf accanto al fuoco: il camino e la panca di quercia dove dorme Bess, la vecchia cassapanca di quercia, il tappeto e la lampada, il candeliere d'ottone, la foto del suo matrimonio, i suoi occhiali e il suo libro di poesie; i crumpet sulla forchetta per tostare, i narcisi di Wordsworth e il nascondino con Poppy.
description.de: Der Raum des alten Wilf am Feuer: der Kamin und die Eichenbank mit hoher Lehne, auf der Bess schläft, die alte Eichentruhe, der Teppich und die Lampe, der Messingleuchter, sein Hochzeitsfoto, seine Brille und sein Gedichtbuch; Crumpets auf der Röstgabel, Wordsworths Narzissen und Verstecken mit Poppy.

words.example_en: Old Wilf lights the fire in the fireplace.
words.example_sl: Stari Wilf zakuri ogenj v kaminu.
words.example_it: Il vecchio Wilf accende il fuoco nel camino.
words.example_de: Der alte Wilf zündet das Feuer im Kamin an.
words.note: The fire burns in the fireplace; the shelf over it is the mantelpiece.
words.note_sl: Ogenj gori v kaminu (fireplace); polica nad njim je mantelpiece.
words.note_it: Il fuoco brucia nel camino (fireplace); la mensola sopra è il mantelpiece.
words.note_de: Das Feuer brennt im Kamin (fireplace); das Brett darüber ist der mantelpiece.

words.example_en: Bess is asleep on the settle.
words.example_sl: Bess spi na klopi z naslonom.
words.example_it: Bess dorme sulla panca con lo schienale.
words.note: A settle is an old wooden bench with a high back, by the fire. The back keeps the draught off.
words.note_sl: Settle je stara lesena klop z visokim naslonom ob ognju. Naslon varuje pred prepihom.
words.note_it: Il settle è una vecchia panca di legno con lo schienale alto, vicino al fuoco: ripara dagli spifferi.
words.note_de: Ein settle ist eine alte Holzbank mit hoher Lehne am Feuer. Die Lehne hält den Zug ab.

words.example_en: There are old letters in the chest.
words.example_it: Nella cassapanca ci sono delle vecchie lettere.
words.example_de: In der Truhe sind alte Briefe.
words.note: A chest is a big wooden box with a lid, for clothes and old things. Your chest is also here, under your chin!
words.note_sl: Chest je velika lesena skrinja s pokrovom za oblačila in stare reči. Chest so tudi prsi!
words.note_it: Il chest è una grande cassa di legno con il coperchio, per i vestiti e le cose vecchie. Chest è anche il petto!
words.note_de: Eine chest ist eine große Holzkiste mit Deckel, für Kleider und alte Sachen. Chest ist auch die Brust!

words.example_en: The rug is in front of the fire.
words.example_it: Il tappeto è davanti al fuoco.
words.example_de: Der Teppich liegt vor dem Feuer.
words.note: A rug is a small carpet. A carpet covers the whole floor.
words.note_sl: Rug je manjša preproga. Carpet pokrije vsa tla.
words.note_it: Il rug è un tappeto piccolo. Il carpet copre tutto il pavimento.
words.note_de: Ein rug ist ein kleiner Teppich. Ein carpet bedeckt den ganzen Boden.

words.example_en: Put the lamp on, it's getting dark.
words.example_it: Accendi la lampada, si fa buio.
words.example_de: Mach die Lampe an, es wird dunkel.
words.note: Put the lamp on, or switch it on: make it shine. Put it off, or switch it off.
words.note_sl: Put the lamp on ali switch it on: prižgi svetilko. Put it off ali switch it off: ugasni jo.
words.note_it: Put the lamp on o switch it on: accendi la lampada. Put it off o switch it off: spegnila.
words.note_de: Put the lamp on oder switch it on: Mach die Lampe an. Put it off oder switch it off: Mach sie aus.

words.example_en: The brass candlestick shines in the corner.
words.example_sl: Medeninast svečnik se sveti v kotu.
words.example_de: Der Messingleuchter glänzt in der Ecke.
words.note: A candlestick holds a candle. Wilf's is brass, and he polishes it on Sundays.
words.note_sl: Candlestick drži svečo. Wilfov je iz medenine in ga ob nedeljah polira.
words.note_it: Il candlestick regge una candela. Quello di Wilf è d'ottone e lo lucida la domenica.
words.note_de: Ein candlestick hält eine Kerze. Wilfs ist aus Messing, und er poliert ihn sonntags.

words.example_en: That's Wilf's wedding photo on the wall.
words.example_sl: Na steni je Wilfova poročna fotografija.
words.example_it: Sul muro c'è la foto del matrimonio di Wilf.
words.example_de: Das an der Wand ist Wilfs Hochzeitsfoto.
words.note: Photo is short for photograph. One photo, two photos: just -s, no -es.
words.note_sl: Photo je kratko za photograph. One photo, two photos: samo -s, brez -es.
words.note_it: Photo è l'abbreviazione di photograph. One photo, two photos: solo -s, senza -es.
words.note_de: Photo ist kurz für photograph. One photo, two photos: nur -s, kein -es.

words.example_en: Where are my glasses? I can't see!
words.example_sl: Kje so moja očala? Nič ne vidim!
words.example_it: Dove sono i miei occhiali? Non vedo niente!
words.example_de: Wo ist meine Brille? Ich sehe nichts!
words.note: Glasses are always plural: my glasses are, not my glasses is. A glass is for water.
words.note_sl: Glasses so vedno v množini: my glasses are, ne my glasses is. A glass je kozarec za vodo.
words.note_it: Glasses è sempre plurale: my glasses are, non my glasses is. A glass è il bicchiere.
words.note_de: Glasses ist immer Plural: my glasses are, nicht my glasses is. A glass ist ein Glas für Wasser.

words.example_en: Wilf reads his book of poems by the fire.
words.example_sl: Wilf ob ognju bere svojo knjigo pesmi.
words.example_it: Wilf legge il suo libro di poesie accanto al fuoco.
words.example_de: Wilf liest am Feuer in seinem Gedichtbuch.
words.note: A book of poems, a book of stories. Read a book, write a book.
words.note_sl: A book of poems: knjiga pesmi. Read a book: brati knjigo.
words.note_it: A book of poems: un libro di poesie. Read a book: leggere un libro.
words.note_de: A book of poems: ein Gedichtbuch. Read a book: ein Buch lesen.

words.example_en: Hot crumpets with butter, by the fire.
words.example_sl: Vroči crumpeti z maslom, ob ognju.
words.example_it: Crumpet caldi con il burro, accanto al fuoco.
words.example_de: Heiße Crumpets mit Butter, am Feuer.
words.note: A crumpet is a soft little round bread full of holes. Toast it, then the butter runs into the holes!
words.note_sl: Crumpet je mehak okrogel kolaček, poln luknjic. Popeci ga, potem maslo steče v luknjice!
words.note_it: Il crumpet è una piccola focaccina morbida e rotonda, piena di buchi. Tostalo, e il burro entra nei buchi!
words.note_de: Ein crumpet ist ein weiches rundes Brötchen voller Löcher. Toaste es, dann läuft die Butter in die Löcher!

words.example_en: Hold the toasting fork near the fire.
words.example_sl: Drži vilice za peko kruha blizu ognja.
words.example_it: Tieni la forchetta per tostare vicino al fuoco.
words.example_de: Halt die Röstgabel nah ans Feuer.
words.note: A long fork for toasting bread or crumpets over the fire, the old way.
words.note_sl: Dolge vilice, s katerimi po starem nad ognjem pečeš kruh ali crumpete.
words.note_it: Una forchetta lunga per tostare il pane o i crumpet sul fuoco, all'antica.
words.note_de: Eine lange Gabel, um Brot oder Crumpets am Feuer zu rösten, wie früher.

words.example_en: Wilf knows Wordsworth's poem by heart.
words.example_sl: Wilf zna Wordsworthovo pesem na pamet.
words.example_it: Wilf sa a memoria la poesia di Wordsworth.
words.note: Know a poem by heart: say it without the book. A poet writes poems.
words.note_sl: Know a poem by heart: znati pesem na pamet. A poet (pesnik) piše poems.
words.note_it: Know a poem by heart: sapere una poesia a memoria. A poet (il poeta) scrive poems.
words.note_de: Know a poem by heart: ein Gedicht auswendig können. A poet (Dichter) schreibt poems.

words.example_en: That's Wilf on his wedding day.
words.example_sl: To je Wilf na dan svoje poroke.
words.example_it: Quello è Wilf il giorno del suo matrimonio.
words.example_de: Das ist Wilf an seinem Hochzeitstag.
words.note: The wedding is the day; the marriage is the years after it.
words.note_sl: Wedding je dan poroke; marriage so leta zakona po njej.
words.note_it: Il wedding è il giorno delle nozze; il marriage sono gli anni dopo.
words.note_de: Die wedding ist der Tag; die marriage sind die Jahre danach.

words.example_en: Let's play hide-and-seek! You count to ten.
words.example_sl: Igrajva se skrivalnice! Ti šteješ do deset.
words.example_it: Giochiamo a nascondino! Tu conti fino a dieci.
words.example_de: Lass uns Verstecken spielen! Du zählst bis zehn.
words.note: Play hide-and-seek. The seeker counts and calls: Coming, ready or not!
words.note_sl: Play hide-and-seek: igrati se skrivalnice. Kdor išče, šteje in zakliče: Coming, ready or not!
words.note_it: Play hide-and-seek: giocare a nascondino. Chi cerca conta e grida: Coming, ready or not!
words.note_de: Play hide-and-seek: Verstecken spielen. Wer sucht, zählt und ruft: Coming, ready or not!
